title: Video: Regina transit employees protest as city locks out workers
html:
Thousands of commuters who rely on transit in Regina were without bus service Monday as workers and the city hit an impasse over a new contract. The city’s imposed a lockout of about 380 transit workers days after the Amalgamated Transit Union Local 588 said employees would take job action by not working voluntary overtime.

The Canadian Press
